Department of Pharmacy，Suzhou Guangji Hospital，Jiangsu Suzhou 215003，China【Abstract】 Ritonavir is an antiretroviral drug， which is often combined with other antiviral drugs to form a compound preparation （such as nimatvir/ritonavir， lopinavir/ritonavir， simnotrelvir/ritonavir， etc.）. Ritonavir is an inhibitor or inducer of a variety of metabolic enzymes， and there is a complex drug-drug interaction when combined with psychotropic drugs. Although the drug instructions and domestic and foreign literature provide suggestions for drug combination， there are still some deficiencies in clinical practice， such as different drug varieties at home and abroad， inconsistent recommendations or inability to implement. On the basis of reviewing literature， the research group developed the pharmacy formulate “Pharmaceutical suggestions on the interaction between antiviral drugs with ritonavir and psychotropic drugs"， based on the current situation in China and clinical practice including the mechanism of drug interaction， changes in blood drug concentration， levels of interaction and pharmaeutical， suggestions， so as to provide reference for clinical practice in psychotropic drug therapy in China.利托那韦是一种拟肽类HIV-1蛋白酶抑制剂，因其可大幅提升CYP3A4底物药物的血药浓度，常与经CYP3A4代谢的其他抗病毒药组成复方制剂，用于治疗 HIV，新型冠状病毒感染（corona virus disease 2019，COVID-19）以及丙型肝炎病毒（human hepa⁃titis C virus，HCV）感染 。
